tweet.text:
Google released new Gemma 4 QAT models, optimized with Quantization-Aware Training to make Gemma 4 run more efficiently on mobile devices, laptops, and consumer GPUs.

The update dramatically reduces memory requirements while preserving more model quality than standard post-training quantization.

Key details:

🔹QAT simulates quantization during training, reducing quality loss when models are compressed.
🔹The release includes checkpoints for the popular Q4_0 quantization format.
🔹Google also introduced a mobile-specialized quantization format for edge devices.
🔹Using the mobile format, Gemma 4 E2B can run with a memory footprint of around 1GB.
🔹The text-only Gemma 4 E2B model can require less than 1GB of memory when unnecessary encoders are removed.
🔹Google optimized static activations, channel-wise quantization, targeted 2-bit compression, embeddings, and KV cache memory.
🔹The models are available on Hugging Face.
🔹Supported tools include llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, LiteRT-LM, Transformers.js, SGLang, vLLM, MLX, Hugging Face Transformers, and Unsloth.
